## Rules

- Number use cases sequentially per app (`UC-01`, `UC-02`, ...); never renumber on
  incremental runs — new runs append with the next free number.
- A use case with no preconditions/postconditions worth stating for a demo is not
  yet specific enough — narrow it or merge it with another.
- For **incremental** mode, append only the use cases new since the last manifest
  run; the prior set stays as written.
